end.parentNote: Harsh practised using the x-coordinate for horizontal movement and the y-coordinate for vertical movement. They correctly identified the quadrants for (3, -2) and (-3, 2), and later corrected the mix-up between (3, 2) and (2, 3) by describing each movement separately. At home, ask Harsh to draw a small coordinate grid and plot three ordered pairs, saying the horizontal and vertical steps aloud.
